topic: Data script modification for facility filtering
summary_markdown: A technical discussion regarding a data copying script (ds_copy.sql). Specifically, the participants discussed whether setting `param_facilityMasterNums = []` correctly removes facility filtering when deleting and inserting data into `ml_2`. It was noted that an existing condition exists for `agg_5`, but [me] realized they had missed this section when adding the facility option and committed to correcting it. The script update was subsequently pushed.
decisions: The data copying script will be corrected to properly handle facility filtering when using `param_facilityMasterNums = []`.
action_items: [me] pushed the necessary code changes to GitHub.
